name: Borusan Yatirim ve Pazarlama A.S.
summary: Borusan Yatirim ve Pazarlama A.S., together with its subsidiaries, engage in the commercial and service sectors in Turkey. The company is also involved in the production of pipe and cold rolled steel coil, as well as engine valves for various types of internal combustion engines; and operates in the construction, resource, energy and transportation industries, as well as automobile and motorcycle segments. In addition, it provides solutions for investment, financing, organization, and management. Borusan Yatirim ve Pazarlama A.S. was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Istanbul, Turkey.
